positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
- Tech Lead across 4 engineering teams, 30+ engineers. Leading in designing, implementing, and launching the FireTV Channels application (https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0942ST2L1), achieving 10+ million monthly active users.
- Architected an Android client and integrated with 10+ backend services for authentication and authorization, content delivery and ingestion, engagement data tracking, and business analytics. Led client and service scale optimization to be able to support 20k transactions per second, across multiple OS and device platforms, including FireTV and FireTablets
- Architected AWS datastore and engagement pipelines to handle 50k transactions per second, enabling personalization and business analytics pipeline
- Interviewed 100+ candidates for Software Development Engineer positions from intern to senior positions. Professionally mentored 8 engineers, guiding them in career growth and impactful engineering practices, with measurable improvements in team productivity and satisfaction

positions.title: Software Development Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Used Tomcat GWT/AJAX Framework to build a service that allows developers to troubleshoot and debug issues when the new labor planning service is launched to fulfillment centers around the world.

Placed 10th in Amazon Coding Competition (out of 150+ Amazonians).

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant in Berkeley Institute for Data Science
positions.description:
Cleantech Business Analysis Tool - Department of Energy/Spark Clean Energy

Created a scalable software tool that scrapes data on startups and hackathon winners using various APIs and web scraping frameworks, and analyzed the trends and key factors that determine the success of these startups. Coded in Python.

Presented our final research findings at Berkeley Innovation Ecosystem Analysis BIDS Data Science Fair Presentation.

https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1kzk9ZqVc-3Q821VMKIwAC4tcyksAmBR1sVh2OWbBfmY/edit?usp=sharing

honors.title: Provincial DECA Virtual Business Challenge Champion
honors.description:
The DECA Virtual Business Challenge is an official DECA competitive event where participants use highly visual simulation software to manage a business. The DECA Virtual Business Challenge (VBC) encourages DECA members to test their skills at managing a business individually or as a team. The VBC culminates in live competitions at the ICDC Nationals.

1st place in VBC Sports, Retailing, and Personal Finance in British Columbia, Canada

projects.title: 32-bit Two-cycle Processor
projects.description: Implemented a simple 32-bit two-cycle pipelined processor using Logism.

projects.title: MIPS Assembler and Linker
projects.description: Created an assembler that translates a subset of the MIPS instruction set to machine code, and a linker that processes object files and generates an executable file. Coded in C and MIPS.
